name: ZMenu IV + Chaos Mod
description: Zolika1351's trainer: godmode and the basics, car spawner with presets, first person, weapon recoil, Quake/Half-Life movement and a chaos mod with more than 500 effects. F7 opens it, the numpad operates it. Parachute support comes along - switch it on in the menu. sauer opens with F8 so the two do not answer on the same key.

sources.note: Fetched from this project's Dropbox mirror. If that fails it has to be supplied by hand: Zolika1351 publishes it on https://zolika1351.pages.dev/mods/ivmenu, and the download there is a MEGA link, which nothing can fetch without a browser. Download it there and drop it into the working directory exactly as it comes.

exclude: asi loader if not using xliveless/
